business_problem: LIC needed to replace multi-hop ETL and batch pipelines that siloed milk-analysis, genetics, and operational data so dairy farmers could receive timely herd-health and breeding insights.
solution_summary: LIC rebuilt its dairy-data estate around an event-driven architecture on Confluent Cloud so milk-analysis, animal-genetics, and operational events no longer move through slow multi-hop ETL chains. Apache Kafka now acts as the continuous backbone for data coming from labs, farms, and partner systems, replacing intermediate landing zones and fragmented point-to-point flows. Apache Flink transforms raw events in motion, cleaning and enriching them into traceable business events and a common data model that downstream teams can reuse. Those shared streams feed herd-health alerts, breeding insights, and broader farmer-support workflows in real time while also making it easier to connect R&D and partner systems securely at scale. The result is a single streaming platform that centralizes data delivery without reintroducing batch lag or duplicate pipelines.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the managed streaming backbone for LIC's event-driven dairy data platform.

solution_components.name: Apache Kafka
solution_components.role: Carries continuous business events from labs, farms, and partner systems instead of multi-hop batch flows.

solution_components.name: Apache Flink
solution_components.role: Cleans, enriches, and republishes raw dairy data for immediate downstream use.

data_flow: Milk-analysis, animal-genetics, R&D, farm, and partner-system data streams through Confluent Cloud and Apache Kafka, where Apache Flink cleans and enriches it into reusable business events and a common data model consumed by herd-health, breeding, and farmer-support applications in real time.
business_outcome: LIC now gives teams and farmers faster herd-health and breeding recommendations, reduces redundant pipelines, and can scale data sharing and innovation without adding more architectural complexity.
